entities.summary: Gleb Olegovich Pisarevskiy is a Russian weightlifter and an honored Master of Sports who won the bronze medal in the 105 kg class at the 2004 Summer Olympics with a 190 kg snatch and a 225 kg clean and jerk. Pisarevskiy is widely regarded as one of the greatest weightlifting technicians of all time.
